name: Cursed Ability Damage (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Ability damage, worshiper of a specific faith or ethos, Cha 13

Benefit(s): The ability damage you deal cannot be healed until a remove curse, break enchantment, limited wish, 4 miracle, remove curse, or wish spell has been cast by a worshiper of a deity or ethos directly opposed to your deity or ethos. A successful Heal check (DC 11 + your Hit Dice) will reveal that this is the case.
